note: Runtime compatibility data. Every entry below was read from Bun's own Node.js compatibility table or the globals section of the same page (the `source` URL); see docs/adr/0001-data-source-policy.md. `status: partial` means part of the module's surface is missing; `status: unimplemented` means importing/using it fails outright.

gaps.name: sea
gaps.note: Single-executable applications are not implemented in Bun; Bun documents `bun build --compile` as the replacement.

gaps.name: async_hooks
gaps.note: AsyncLocalStorage and AsyncResource work; createHook and related are stubs with async ids always 0, and context does not propagate into MessagePort/BroadcastChannel/Worker events.

gaps.name: child_process
gaps.note: IPC handles net/dgram sockets but not http server sockets; 'advanced' serialization only works between Bun processes; channel.ref()/unref() are missing.

gaps.name: cluster
gaps.note: net/dgram sharing works as in Node; HTTP load-balancing across processes works only on Linux via SO_REUSEPORT and is not battle-tested.

gaps.name: crypto
gaps.note: BoringSSL-backed: ed448, x448, rsa-pss, dsa, dh, ML-KEM-512, secp256k1 and several ciphers are unavailable; encapsulate/decapsulate are missing; setEngine() throws and setFips() is a no-op.

gaps.name: diagnostics_channel
gaps.note: channel(), subscribe(), tracingChannel() and the http/http2/dgram channels work; boundedChannel() and several built-in channels are missing, and subscribers do not keep a Channel alive.

gaps.name: domain
gaps.note: Only synchronous errors are caught in run()/bind() or by emitters added with add(); asynchronous errors are not routed to the domain.

gaps.name: https
gaps.note: request, get, Agent and globalAgent are implemented with pooling; https.Server is http.Server with TLS options and lacks getPeerCertificate(), getCipher(), setSecureContext(), SNICallback and handshakeTimeout.

gaps.name: inspector
gaps.note: Session supports Profiler, Runtime.enable and NodeTracing; Debugger commands are forwarded but results are not returned; Runtime.evaluate and HeapProfiler are unimplemented and there is no Network domain.

gaps.name: module
gaps.note: Module#load(), registerHooks, findPackageJSON, stripTypeScriptTypes and source-map support APIs are missing; some methods are no-ops.

gaps.name: perf_hooks
gaps.note: monitorEventLoopDelay, createHistogram, timerify and PerformanceObserver are implemented; gc/dns/resource entries are never emitted and eventLoopUtilization() returns zeros.

gaps.name: process
gaps.note: process.binding is only partially available; setting process.title is a no-op on macOS/Linux; several methods return empty arrays; sourceMapsEnabled and addUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback are missing.

gaps.name: repl
gaps.note: Mostly implemented via bun --interactive; there are no result previews and tab-completion skips let/const/class bindings.

gaps.name: test
gaps.note: The in-process API works under bun test; run() is limited and reporters, snapshots, coverage, --test-only and the CLI runner mode are missing.

gaps.name: tls
gaps.note: pskCallback, OCSP stapling and cross-process session resumption are missing; renegotiate() always fails because the TLS layer is BoringSSL.

gaps.name: v8
gaps.note: Heap snapshots/statistics and GCProfiler are implemented; serialize/deserialize use JSC's wire format; queryObjects, CPU/heap profiles, Serializer/Deserializer and promiseHooks are missing.

gaps.name: wasi
gaps.note: args, env, preopens, wasiImport and start() work; getImportObject(), initialize() and sock_accept are missing and several options are ignored.

gaps.name: worker_threads
gaps.note: resourceLimits and trackUnmanagedFds are ignored; some execArgv flags are only partly applied; moveMessagePortToContext and locks are missing.

globalGaps.name: navigator
globalGaps.note: The navigator global exists, but navigator.language, navigator.languages and navigator.locks are missing; userAgentData is also absent.

globalGaps.name: localStorage
globalGaps.note: Bun has no Storage global: localStorage and sessionStorage are unavailable and referencing them throws.

globalGaps.name: sessionStorage
globalGaps.note: Bun has no Storage global: sessionStorage and localStorage are unavailable and referencing them throws.

globalGaps.name: QuotaExceededError
globalGaps.note: The QuotaExceededError global is not implemented in Bun.
